finding: The newly landed intermediate contrastive protocol documented wrong-layer and lesion/rescue evidence as required, but adjudicate_holdout initialized both checks to true and did not require either measurement to be present. A holdout with no such fields could therefore reach the causal-candidate verdict if the remaining matched controls passed.

coordination.reason: No shared immutable reproducible macrocycle/request identity was exposed for this go; available user-message time had only minute precision.

tracks.A: Strengthens executable promotion-path correctness by closing a fail-open causal-evidence gate.
tracks.B: Hardens the reusable HCU/J-Space causal-control primitive and preserves fail-closed evidence authority.
tracks.C: Makes intermediate-layer representation traces safer for later leak-resistant dataset/training readiness without granting model credit.
